svg.title: CaseVera — Agentic Fraud Investigation
svg.desc: CaseVera: Policy-constrained investigation agent: multi-hop graph traversal, point-in-time GraphRAG, provenance-tracked evidence and SAR narratives written back to TigerGraph. 10 GSQL queries; 2 / 2 hidden patterns; 617K graph vertices. Recognition: Top 25 · Tigergraph × Hhg Goa. Tech: TigerGraph, GSQL, GraphRAG, Python, React.

g.text: evidence and SAR narratives written back to TigerGraph.
